description: This is a PHPUnit test case class for testing the CompanyStructureDao in the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup and multiple test methods verifying CRUD operations and tree structure management for Subunit entities.

classes.name: CompanyStructureDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test case class for testing various CRUD methods and tree structure operations of CompanyStructureDao involving Subunit entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, creating an instance of CompanyStructureDao and populating test data from YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testSetOrganizationName
methods.description: Tests setting the organization name through the DAO, expecting a return value of 1.

methods.name: testGetSubunitById
methods.description: Fetches a subunit by ID and asserts it is an instance of Subunit with expected ID and name.

methods.name: testSaveSubunit
methods.description: Creates and saves a new Subunit, asserting it is persisted and has an assigned ID.

methods.name: testDeleteSubunit
methods.description: Deletes a subunit and verifies the resulting tree reflects the deletion, confirming the subunit no longer exists.

methods.name: testAddSubunit
methods.description: Adds a subunit under a parent and verifies the hierarchical structure is updated accordingly.

methods.name: testGetSubunitTreeObject
methods.description: Fetches the full subunit tree and checks that key properties (level, Rgt, Lft) are present.
